Name: Audit Logging
Engineering Requirement: Log all access to sensitive data with who/what/when/where/outcome; immutable append-only log store
Verification Method: Automated log review; SIEM alerts; annual audit review
Gotcha: Logs must be tamper-proof — don't store in the same DB as application data; use write-once storage
Penalty: Financial penalties + loss of SOC2 certification + customer trust

Name: Encryption at Rest
Engineering Requirement: All sensitive data encrypted at rest using AES-256 or equivalent; key rotation every 90 days
Verification Method: Automated checks for unencrypted volumes/buckets; key rotation audit
Gotcha: Default encryption on S3/RDS is not enough — verify application-level encryption for sensitive fields
Penalty: HIPAA: up to $1.5M/year per violation category; PCI: $5K-100K/month fines

Name: Encryption in Transit
Engineering Requirement: All network communication uses TLS 1.2+ minimum; mTLS for service-to-service; no plaintext secrets in transit
Verification Method: TLS scanner; certificate monitoring; network policy enforcement
Gotcha: TLS 1.0/1.1 are deprecated — ensure all clients support TLS 1.2+; watch for certificate expiration
Penalty: PCI non-compliance can result in inability to process card payments

Name: Access Control (RBAC/ABAC)
Engineering Requirement: Implement least-privilege access; role-based or attribute-based access control; regular access reviews
Verification Method: Quarterly access reviews; automated permission drift detection
Gotcha: Service accounts often accumulate excessive permissions over time; audit them too
Penalty: SOC2 audit finding; potential data breach liability

Name: Data Retention and Deletion
Engineering Requirement: Implement automated data retention policies; support right-to-deletion requests within 30 days
Verification Method: Automated retention enforcement; deletion verification scripts
Gotcha: Backups and replicas must also be purged — deletion from primary DB is not enough
Penalty: GDPR: up to 4% of global annual revenue or €20M whichever is higher

Name: Consent Management
Engineering Requirement: Collect explicit consent before processing personal data; maintain consent records; support withdrawal
Verification Method: Consent audit trail; automated compliance checks
Gotcha: Consent must be granular (per-purpose) and freely given; pre-checked boxes are invalid under GDPR
Penalty: GDPR: up to 4% of global annual revenue

Name: Data Breach Notification
Engineering Requirement: Notify supervisory authority within 72h of breach discovery (GDPR); 60 days for HIPAA
Verification Method: Incident response runbook; breach detection monitoring; notification templates
Gotcha: 72h starts from awareness not occurrence; document the timeline meticulously
Penalty: GDPR: fines for late notification; HIPAA: $100-$50K per violation

Name: PCI DSS Network Segmentation
Engineering Requirement: Isolate cardholder data environment (CDE) from other networks; firewall rules; micro-segmentation
Verification Method: Quarterly network scans; annual penetration testing; segmentation verification
Gotcha: Flat networks fail PCI audits; even internal traffic to CDE must be controlled
Penalty: Loss of ability to process card payments; fines up to $500K per incident

Name: PHI Access Controls
Engineering Requirement: Minimum necessary access to Protected Health Information; audit trail for all PHI access
Verification Method: Access log review; automated anomaly detection on PHI access patterns
Gotcha: HIPAA applies to business associates too — your SaaS vendor accessing PHI must also comply
Penalty: Civil penalties $100-$50K per violation; criminal up to $250K + imprisonment

Name: Vulnerability Management
Engineering Requirement: Scan for vulnerabilities regularly; patch critical CVEs within 30 days; maintain SBOM
Verification Method: Automated vulnerability scanning (Snyk/Trivy/Grype); SLA tracking for remediation
Gotcha: Container base images accumulate CVEs quickly; automate base image updates
Penalty: SOC2 audit finding; PCI requires quarterly ASV scans

Name: Change Management
Engineering Requirement: All production changes through documented approval process; no direct production access
Verification Method: PR reviews; deployment audit trail; change advisory board for high-risk changes
Gotcha: Emergency changes still need retroactive documentation within 24h
Penalty: SOC2 audit finding if changes are undocumented

Name: Data Residency
Engineering Requirement: Store and process data in the region specified by regulation; no cross-border transfers without adequacy
Verification Method: Data flow mapping; infrastructure audit; transfer impact assessments
Gotcha: CDN edge caches and log aggregation services can inadvertently transfer data across borders
Penalty: GDPR: fines for unauthorized cross-border transfers; Schrems II implications

Name: Secure Software Development
Engineering Requirement: Implement secure SDLC: threat modeling; code review; SAST/DAST; dependency scanning
Verification Method: CI/CD pipeline security gates; annual secure coding training
Gotcha: Security scanning must run on every PR not just releases; false positives erode developer trust
Penalty: SOC2/PCI audit finding; potential vulnerability exposure

Name: Business Continuity / DR
Engineering Requirement: Documented and tested disaster recovery plan; RPO/RTO defined per service tier; annual DR drill
Verification Method: Annual DR test with documented results; RPO/RTO measurement
Gotcha: DR plans that aren't tested don't work; paper compliance is not actual resilience
Penalty: SOC2 audit finding; business risk during actual disaster

Name: Third-Party Risk Management
Engineering Requirement: Assess security posture of all vendors processing sensitive data; maintain vendor inventory; review annually
Verification Method: Vendor security questionnaires; SOC2 report review; contract SLA verification
Gotcha: Sub-processors (your vendor's vendors) also need assessment under GDPR and SOC2
Penalty: SOC2 audit finding; shared liability for vendor breaches
